aws.terrain-tiles.name: Terrain Tiles (terrarium)
aws.terrain-tiles.summary: Global elevation packed into RGB tiles, aggregated from SRTM, USGS 3DEP, GMTED2010 and other public sources. Used for hillshading and for elevation outside the United States.
aws.terrain-tiles.attribution: Terrain Tiles on AWS Open Data — data from USGS, NASA, NGA and other public sources

usgs.contours.name: USGS Elevation Contours
usgs.contours.summary: Elevation contour lines generated by The National Map from 3DEP elevation data, published at several scales with contour intervals appropriate to each.
usgs.contours.attribution: Contours courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map

usgs.shadedrelief.name: USGS Shaded Relief
usgs.shadedrelief.summary: A shaded relief basemap generated from USGS 3D Elevation Program data.
usgs.shadedrelief.attribution: Shaded relief courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map

usgs.topo.name: US Topo
usgs.topo.summary: The current USGS topographic basemap, combining boundaries, hydrography, transportation, contours and geographic names.
usgs.topo.attribution: Map services and data available from U.S. Geological Survey, National Geospatial Program

usgs.transportation.name: USGS Transportation
usgs.transportation.summary: Roads, trails and railways from The National Map, drawn transparently so they can be laid over imagery.
usgs.transportation.attribution: Transportation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map

layers.name: Contours
layers.summary: Contour lines on a clear background — the layer to use over imagery or geology, since only the lines are drawn.

layers.name: Hillshade
layers.summary: Relief shading computed from global elevation data, showing the shape of the terrain.

layers.name: Topographic Map
layers.summary: The complete USGS topographic sheet. It has an opaque printed background, so lowering its opacity fades the whole sheet rather than revealing what is beneath — for lines over imagery use Contours, or pick Topographic as the base map.

layers.name: Roads & Trails
layers.summary: Roads, trails and railways from The National Map, drawn on a clear background.

layers.name: USGS Shaded Relief
layers.summary: Shaded relief produced by USGS from 3DEP elevation data, at higher quality than the global hillshade but only across the United States.
